findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/AffineSpace/AffineMap.lean:126 `theorem map_vadd (f : P1 →ᵃ[k] P2) (p : P1) (v : V1) : f (v +ᵥ p) = f.linear v +ᵥ f p`.

summary: Three proofs re-derive reasoning the PR already proves elsewhere (FM bound argument, sweep halfspace presentation, prism-coordinate uniqueness), and one rewrites through the structure field `map_vadd'` with a long `simpa only` coercion chain.
